data.title: Gantt Chart
data.tagline: A schedule chart that uses timeline bars to show task dates, duration, milestones, and dependencies
data.learningOutcome: You can read task dates, duration, dependencies, and milestones from a Gantt chart and identify what a delay affects.
data.description: A release can require interaction design before development and testing. If development moves, dependent testing and the launch milestone move too. A Gantt chart exposes schedule impact, but unknown durations should not become invented dates.

learning.assumes: You need to coordinate task timing and sequence but may confuse direction, ordering, and scheduling.
learning.outcome: You can read task dates, duration, dependencies, and milestones from a Gantt chart and identify what a delay affects.

explanation.title: Bars encode dates and duration
explanation.text: Position shows start and finish, while length shows duration.

explanation.title: Dependencies expose schedule impact
explanation.text: When a predecessor moves, connected tasks and milestones may move with it.

explanation.title: Estimates preserve uncertainty
explanation.text: Unknown duration, external approval, and risky dependencies need visible labels rather than invented dates.

data.boundary: A Gantt Chart schedules selected tasks, a Product Roadmap explains product direction, and a Product Backlog orders candidate work.

lessonPractice.title: Which information belongs in the Gantt chart for a trip-collaboration feature?

options.label: Interaction design takes 3 days; development takes 5 days after design; testing takes 2 days after development; passing tests is the release milestone
options.feedback: Correct. It contains tasks, durations, dependencies, and a milestone that can be placed on a timeline.

options.label: This year we want more travelers to collaborate successfully with companions
options.feedback: That is a product goal suited to a roadmap, not yet a set of schedulable tasks.

options.label: Set every unknown task to finish tomorrow afternoon so the chart looks complete
options.feedback: Invented dates distort dependencies and risk. Unknown estimates should remain visibly unresolved.

data.agentPrompt: Using these confirmed tasks, owners, durations, and dependencies, draft a Gantt chart for the trip-collaboration feature. Show task dates, dependency links, and the release milestone, then simulate a two-day development delay. Mark missing durations or dependencies as estimates needed instead of inventing dates. Finish with the dependencies that can move the release and the risks still open.
